pr_metadata.title: fix(obs): retry the grafana port-forward verify so it doesn't race the relay restart
pr_metadata.summary: The observe phase's grafana health check curled localhost:3000 once immediately after restarting the port-forward relay, racing its re-bind and flaking bootstrap with connection-refused; add --retry-connrefused so it waits the relay out, still fail-loud after the budget.
pr_metadata.notes: Surfaced by the epic-198 #1022 cold boot (all phases failed=0, then exit 7 on this verify; Grafana healthy seconds later). One-line behavior change in phases.py + a test asserting the retry flag. Cloud-safe (no workflow files). vrg-validate green. Verify after merge with a cold mqlab bootstrap completing exit 0 through the observe verify — folded into the #1022 re-run.
